sources.title: VQA: Visual Question Answering
sources.authority_reason: Original authors paper hosted on arXiv; version checked from PDF header and arXiv submission history.
sources.inspection_note: Read abstract and introduction p.1: image plus natural-language question targets details/count/activity. Its broader commonsense questions are not used to assert a visible-only rule for all VQA.

sources.title: Making the V in VQA Matter
sources.authority_reason: Original VQA v2 authors paper; PDF header and original arXiv history inspected.
sources.inspection_note: Abstract/introduction pp.1-2; section 3.1 complementary real image pairs. Same question, similar images, distinct correct answers; superficial language priors can obscure grounding. No course-model result inferred.

sources.title: Object Hallucination in Image Captioning
sources.authority_reason: ACL Anthology conference publisher version; original authors and proceeding header inspected.
sources.inspection_note: Read abstract, section 1 p.4035, section 2.1 p.4036: caption similarity does not fully capture relevance; captions are summaries; CHAIR only detects the studied MSCOCO object hallucinations, not all activity or intent errors.

sources.title: DOCCI: Descriptions of Connected and Contrasting Images
sources.authority_reason: Original Google/Princeton/UNC authors paper; original arXiv history contains only v1 and official Google site identifies paper.
sources.inspection_note: Read abstract, figures 1-2, section 2.1 Contrastive Images p.5 and datasheet relationships p.31: human English descriptions, same cats with different poses/actions, k-means grouping.

source_verification.details: Personally read original authors VQA/VQA-v2/CHAIR/DOCCI papers, official Google DOCCI, Python 3.13 and scikit-learn 1.9.1 method docs; verified actual version/authority/locators. Candidate locator database only led to a prior v2 paper path; new downloaded v3 PDF header was independently checked. Exact necessary original raw cat source lines permanently copied and SHA checked.

limitations.details: No new model inference/image-swap score, heldout capability test, training or GPU run. Cards are hand-written, cat is train material, semantic method/data audits are not model outcomes. Limited contrasts and declared similarity groups do not establish generalization, independent entities/sessions, pixel uniqueness or upstream unseen data. Original final paragraph is guidance, not an acceptance claim.
